dedupe_keys.name: code for paper the potential role of a hydrogen network in europe

description: The spatial-sector research team publishes an MIT-licensed European energy-system model workflow for a paper on hydrogen networks. Zenodo archives the version 1.0.1 source repository, which is also public on GitHub. The README describes a PyPSA-Eur-Sec-based sector-coupled model with 181 regions and three-hour time steps. Scenarios vary electricity and hydrogen network expansion, gas-pipeline reuse and hydrogen storage while meeting net-zero carbon constraints. This model can compare transmission and hydrogen infrastructure needs under renewable variability. Related catalogue model-pypsa-eur is a separate parent modelling framework, not this paper’s configured workflow. Coverage is the European regions and scenario assumptions used by the authors, not an approved network development plan. A limitation is that the reproduction instructions require a high-performance computing environment and the paper’s input datasets; changes to cost or route assumptions can alter results. A second, much larger Zenodo archive appears to share this model version but does not document its internal difference. Neither archive was downloaded or run.
